dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is there anything I should take note of nearby?

dialogues.speaker: Kagawa
dialogues.text: If you asked me, I'd say that the scenery here in Watatsumi Island is the most notable thing.

dialogues.speaker: Kagawa
dialogues.text: Immersing yourself in nature as you train is a truly satisfying experience.

dialogues.speaker: Kagawa
dialogues.text: Mm, yes... Getting closer to nature is also part of training.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Training?

dialogues.speaker: Kagawa
dialogues.text: That's right. I believe that people need to go out and train more while they're young. Only by absorbing the essence of both the sun and moon can one really train one's body and soul.

dialogues.speaker: Kagawa
dialogues.text: You see, the blooming of flowers mark the changing of the seasons, and the flow of this waterfall marks the flow of time.

dialogues.speaker: Kagawa
dialogues.text: We all live in nature, and we should appreciate its beauty rather than bury our heads in work all the time...

dialogues.speaker: Kagawa
dialogues.text: Wait, uh, I mean, you can only work at your best after you've trained yourself, am I right?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Kagawa
dialogues.text: Farewell. Remember to smell the flowers and take in the sights as you travel.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: That's a pretty good point.

dialogues.speaker: Kagawa
dialogues.text: Exactly! I met a young samurai with a streak of red in his hair, and he said so too.

dialogues.speaker: Kagawa
dialogues.text: ...I'm not sure if this was the precise meaning of his words, but it's a sure bet that he's a nature-lover, just like me.

dialogues.speaker: Kagawa
dialogues.text: Not to mention that his abilities were way above mine, too! He could apparently tell what the weather would be just from the movement of the wind and grass. He must have reached the apex of training, I'm sure of it!

dialogues.speaker: Kagawa
dialogues.text: Ah, nature is so lovely. I, too, must train harder.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You're just lazing around, aren't you?

dialogues.speaker: Kagawa
dialogues.text: Oh, come on, read the room.

dialogues.speaker: Kagawa
dialogues.text: Life is short but the flowers are lovely. There's no need to rush.

dialogues.speaker: Kagawa
dialogues.text: Take these. I hope it all goes well with you.
